summary: CWE-500 flags a public static field that is not final, allowing it to be mutated by any code. The field DEFAULT_ERROR holds a constant error message and is never reassigned, so marking it `final` closes the exposure while preserving the feature: bad() still reads and writes the same message via IO.writeLine.

edits.old: public static String DEFAULT_ERROR = "The value you entered was not understood.  Please try again.";
edits.new: public static final String DEFAULT_ERROR = "The value you entered was not understood.  Please try again.";
